code:
import json, sys
E = "studies/rlneurons/results/xreward/edits/"
R = json.load(open(E + "readout.json"))["cells"]
cells = {"top8_math31": "top8_math31-01", "top8x1.5_math31": "top8x1.5_math31-01", "top8x0.5_math31": "top8x0.5_math31-01",
         "top8x2_math31": "top8x2_math31-01", "rand8_math31": "rand8_math31-01", "rand8x1.5_math31": "rand8x1.5_math31-01", "rand8x3_math31": "rand8x3_math31-01"}
out = {"command": "uv run --no-project python <this code, inlined in exact1x-01/offline.json key code> (reads " + E + "<cell>/edit.json and readout.json)",
       "code": open(sys.argv[1]).read(), "cells": {}}
for c, d in cells.items():
    e = json.load(open(E + d + "/edit.json"))
    t = e["totals"]
    resid = (t["written_norm"] ** 2 - 2 * t["effective_scale"] * t["add_norm"] ** 2 + (t["effective_scale"] * t["add_norm"]) ** 2) ** 0.5
    out["cells"][c] = {"edit_json": E + d + "/edit.json", "recipe": e["recipe"], "scale": R[c]["edit"]["scale"], "rounding": e["rounding"], "rounding_seed": e["seed"],
                       "add_norm": t["add_norm"], "written_norm": t["written_norm"], "written_over_add": t["written_norm"] / t["add_norm"],
                       "effective_scale": t["effective_scale"], "cos_written_add": t["cos_written_add"], "add_rel": t["add_rel"],
                       "written_rel": t["written_norm"] / t["ref_norm"], "residual_norm_orthogonal_to_addition": resid,
                       "hard328_right_v3": R[c]["right_v3"], "cap_hits": R[c]["cap_hits"], "mean_generated_tokens": R[c]["mean_generated_tokens"], "job_id": R[c]["job_id"]}
b = R["base_cue_T1"]
out["base_cue_T1"] = {"hard328_right_v3": b["right_v3"], "cap_hits": b["cap_hits"], "mean_generated_tokens": b["mean_generated_tokens"]}
json.dump(out, open("studies/theory/results/experiments/exact1x-01/offline.json", "w"), indent=1)
for c, v in out["cells"].items():
    print(c, {k: round(v[k], 5) if isinstance(v[k], float) else v[k] for k in ("scale", "rounding", "add_norm", "written_norm", "effective_scale", "cos_written_add", "residual_norm_orthogonal_to_addition", "hard328_right_v3", "cap_hits")})
print("base_cue_T1", out["base_cue_T1"])
